en.text: I want to die on Mars, just not on impact.

zh.text: 我想死在火星上，只是不要在撞击时死。
zh.context: 回答关于火星雄心的问题

en.text: I think it is important for humanity to become a multi-planetary species.

zh.text: 我认为人类成为一个多行星物种是非常重要的。

en.text: You want to wake up in the morning and think the future is going to be great — and that's what being a spacefaring civilization is all about.

zh.text: 你希望在早晨醒来时认为未来会很美好——这就是成为太空文明的意义所在。

en.text: Mars is the next frontier. We need to colonize Mars to ensure the survival of the human species.

zh.text: 火星是下一个前沿。我们需要殖民火星以确保人类物种的生存。

en.text: The Starship is the vehicle that will take us to Mars. It's the most powerful rocket ever built.

zh.text: 星舰是将带我们前往火星的飞行器。它是有史以来最强大的火箭。

en.text: I'm talking about building a self-sustaining city on Mars with a million people.

zh.text: 我说的是在火星上建立一个拥有一百万人的自给自足的城市。

en.text: The first Starship to Mars will be unmanned. We want to make sure it works before sending people.

zh.text: 第一艘前往火星的星舰将是无人驾驶的。我们要确保它在载人之前能够正常工作。

en.text: The window to become multi-planetary is open now, but it won't be open forever. We need to move fast.

zh.text: 成为多行星物种的窗口现在敞开着，但它不会永远敞开。我们需要加快速度。

en.text: Earth is four and a half billion years old. There's no guarantee it will last forever. We need a backup.

zh.text: 地球有45亿年的历史。没有保证它会永远存在。我们需要一个备份。
zh.context: 论证火星殖民的合理性

en.text: The reason SpaceX exists is to make humanity multi-planetary. Everything else is secondary.

zh.text: SpaceX存在的原因是让人类成为多行星物种。其他一切都是次要的。

en.text: We're building Starship to be rapidly reusable. That's the key to making Mars colonization affordable.

zh.text: 我们正在建造可快速重复使用的星舰。这是使火星殖民变得可负担的关键。
zh.context: 星舰可重复使用性讨论

en.text: The cost of a ticket to Mars will eventually be about the cost of a median house in the United States.

zh.text: 去火星的票价最终大约相当于美国中等房价。

en.text: I can't wait to see the first humans walk on Mars. That will be incredible.

zh.text: 我迫不及待想看到第一批人类踏上火星。那将是令人难以置信的。

en.text: The atmosphere on Mars is mostly CO2. We can use that to make fuel with the Sabatier process.

zh.text: 火星的大气主要由CO2组成。我们可以利用萨巴蒂尔工艺用CO2制造燃料。
zh.context: 关于火星资源的技术讨论

en.text: SpaceX has already spent billions on Starship development. We'll spend whatever it takes.

zh.text: SpaceX已经在星舰开发上花费了数十亿美元。我们会不惜一切代价。

en.text: The launch cost per kilogram to low Earth orbit has dropped dramatically thanks to Falcon 9 reusability.

zh.text: 由于猎鹰9号的可重复使用性，每公斤进入低地球轨道的发射成本已经大幅下降。

en.text: We're aiming for the first uncrewed Starship mission to Mars in the 2026 transfer window.

zh.text: 我们的目标是在2026年的火星转移窗口期进行首次无人星舰火星任务。

en.text: The Starship catch by the tower was a historic moment. We proved that orbital-class boosters can be reused.

zh.text: 星舰被发射塔接住是一个历史性时刻。我们证明了轨道级助推器可以被重复使用。

en.text: I used to sleep on the factory floor at SpaceX. That's how much I care about this mission.

zh.text: 我过去经常睡在SpaceX工厂的地板上。这就是我对这个使命的重视程度。

en.text: The first three launches of Falcon 1 all failed. If the fourth had failed, SpaceX would have been done.

zh.text: 猎鹰1号的前三次发射都失败了。如果第四次也失败了，SpaceX就完了。

en.text: The Raptor engine is the most complex and advanced rocket engine ever built.

zh.text: 猛禽引擎是有史以来最复杂、最先进的火箭引擎。

en.text: I think we should send people to Mars as soon as possible. Every year we delay is a year we might not have.

zh.text: 我认为我们应该尽快将人送往火星。我们每推迟一年，就可能失去一年。
zh.context: 敦促加快火星殖民速度

en.text: The view from Mars would be incredible. Imagine looking up and seeing Earth as a small blue dot.

zh.text: 从火星上看到的景色将是令人难以置信的。想象一下抬头看到地球作为一个小蓝点。

en.text: We need to be out there among the stars. Staying on Earth forever is not an option.

zh.text: 我们需要在星际之间。永远留在地球不是一个选项。

en.text: The SpaceX team has done an incredible job. Starship is the most complex vehicle ever built.

zh.text: SpaceX团队做得非常出色。星舰是有史以来最复杂的飞行器。

en.text: I remember watching the Apollo moon landings as a kid. That's what inspired me to think about space.

zh.text: 我记得小时候看阿波罗登月。那就是启发我思考太空的原因。

en.text: The moon is a stepping stone, but Mars is the destination. We should have a permanent presence on both.

zh.text: 月球是垫脚石，但火星是目的地。我们应该在两者上都有永久存在。

en.text: SpaceX will land humans on Mars well before 2030. That's the goal.

zh.text: SpaceX将在2030年之前将人类送上火星。这就是目标。

en.text: The beauty of space is that it forces you to think big. There's no room for small thinking in space exploration.

zh.text: 太空的美在于它迫使你大胆思考。太空探索中没有小思维的空间。

en.text: We're going to build a city on Mars. It's going to be awesome.

zh.text: 我们将在火星上建造一座城市。那将会非常棒。
